description: This file defines a Doctrine ORM entity class 'SelectedCompositeDisplayField' which maps to a database table 'ohrm_selected_composite_display_field'. It models a composite display field selection for reports in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class contains properties for identifiers and relationships to other entities, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: SelectedCompositeDisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing associations between composite display fields and reports in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the selected composite display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the selected composite display field.
